title: Finalize project license and npm package metadata
description:
Finalize the repository/package-level licensing and npm metadata story separately from rules/adventure content-source legality.

This is about the Loreweaver source code/package metadata, not about approving any third-party adventure or rules corpus.

## Context
Observed gap:
- README appears to say the project license is not finalized.
- Package manifests should make the intended publish/private/license status explicit.
- This is distinct from loreweaver-9s6, which tracks legal source confirmation for converting a third-party adventure into module schema.

Parallel-safety:
- Docs/package metadata only.
- Avoid changing importer code or content-policy decisions.
design:
Suggested files to inspect/update:
- README.md
- LICENSE or equivalent, if a license decision exists
- package.json
- packages/core/package.json
- packages/cli/package.json
- any package publication docs

Implementation guidance:
1. Determine the current intended state from existing repo docs:
   - If license is chosen, add/update LICENSE and package license metadata.
   - If license is not chosen, explicitly mark packages private/unpublished where appropriate and document the decision gate.
2. Add package metadata that is safe and non-controversial:
   - description
   - repository
   - license or private status
3. Clarify distinction between:
   - Loreweaver source code license
   - generated/bundled rules pack content licenses
   - adventure/module source legality
4. Do not resolve the third-party adventure/legal-source bead here.
acceptance_criteria:
- Project source-code license state is explicit: either finalized with LICENSE/package metadata, or explicitly deferred with private/unpublished package settings.
- package.json files have consistent description/repository/license-or-private metadata.
- README distinguishes code license from rules/adventure content licensing.
- loreweaver-9s6 remains the owner for third-party adventure source legality.
- Existing tests/checks pass.
notes:
Baseline setup evidence: in-repo worktree D:/src/loreweaver/.worktrees/loreweaver-0jq-21 fails npm run check before edits because Biome processes 0 files; biome.json excludes !**/.worktrees and .gitignore ignores .worktrees/. Will recreate as a sibling bd worktree outside the repo directory so documented gates can run.
Worktree baseline: D:/src/loreweaver-0jq-21 on branch work/loreweaver-0jq-21; npm install succeeded on Node v24.14.1; npm run check passed (232 files); npm run typecheck passed; npm run test passed (1179 passed, 3 skipped across 90 files).
Implementation plan: no LICENSE file or chosen source-code license found; keep source license deferred, mark root/core/cli packages private-unpublished, add safe description/repository metadata, and clarify README License section so code licensing is separate from bundled rules/content licenses and third-party adventure legality (owned by loreweaver-9s6).
close_reason: Documented deferred source-code license state with private/unpublished package guards; added package descriptions and repository metadata; clarified README/docs split between source license, bundled content licensing, and third-party adventure legality. Verification: npm run check, npm run typecheck, and npm run test passed.
